BEGIN;

DROP INDEX IF EXISTS task_test_variant_source_key_unique_idx;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS task_test_source_key_unique_idx;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS task_source_key_unique_idx;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS lesson_source_key_unique_idx;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS section_source_key_unique_idx;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS module_source_key_unique_idx;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS course_source_key_unique_idx;

ALTER TABLE task_test_variant DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS source_key;
ALTER TABLE task_test DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS source_key;
ALTER TABLE task DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS source_key;
ALTER TABLE lesson DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS source_key;
ALTER TABLE section DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS source_key;
ALTER TABLE module DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS source_key;
ALTER TABLE course DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS source_key;

COMMIT;
